window_rationale: 60s primary: ~2400 S(t) vectors over 5 days 8h/day, ~1167 flows/window avg, captures DoS Hulk ramp 30-60s, stable vs 10s noisy/30s alt. See design report table.
derivation: GroupBy window on Timestamp; aggregate flows whose Timestamp falls in window. No label-derived fields in input S(t) to prevent leakage.

label_overlay_for_evaluation_only.dominant_attack: most frequent Label per window (not in input)
label_overlay_for_evaluation_only.note: attack_ratio/dominant_attack used for target/eval, never as input feature unless experiment explicitly documents supervised state

formulations.A_state_forecast: S(t-W+1..t) -> S(t+1..t+k) MSE on 21 dims, then derive attack_prob = f(S_pred)
formulations.B_attack_prob: S(t-W+1..t) -> P(attack|t+k) CrossEntropy on dominant_attack or Binary malicious

B_transformable: Total Length of Fwd Packet->Tot sum
C_dataset_specific: Dst Port, Src IP dec, Flow Duration, FWD Init Win Bytes (only in CICIDS)

scaling: StandardScaler fitted on TRAIN only, applied to VAL/TEST

sequence.shapes: X_seq [N, W=10, 21], y_attack [N, K], S_next [N, K, 21]
